faqs.a:
The traffic engineer and neighborhood residents shall work together to cooperatively
               resolve transportation issues or neighborhood traffic problems in a manner that is
               consistent with accepted traffic engineering standards, principles and criteria, law
               enforcement objectives and public education.
(Code 1981, § 17-137; Ord. No. 2923, § 1, 11-19-1992; Ord. No. 3081, § 3, 6-6-1994;
Ord. No. 4561, § 2, 8-29-2016
)
